name: Dashboard shows footprint breakdown and top recommendation for a logged-in user with activities
description: A user who has completed onboarding lands on the dashboard and sees their annual CO₂e total, the four category breakdown bars, and a top opportunity recommendation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth/login and sign in with email 'demo@offset.io' and password 'Password123!'
Verify the 'Footprint Overview' header band is visible and the annual total in tonnes CO₂e per year is displayed (a numeric value followed by 't CO₂e / year')
Verify the 'Your breakdown' section shows four category bars for Transport, Home energy, Food, and Goods & waste, each with a percentage share
Verify the 'Top opportunity' or 'Build a reduction plan' action area is visible in the right column of the main spread
